results.rationale: Consistency: The white background and dark cookware appearance remain, but the long handle rotates to a shallower angle and is cropped at the right edge, and the pot body is broadened/recontoured. Lid movement is excluded. Instruction: The lid has moved from beside the opening to above it; a fully compliant result would seat it on the pot rim. It covers much of the opening but projects far beyond the right rim and leaves a visible gap on the left, so placement is incomplete. Quality: Structure/contact is problematic: the oversized, offset lid does not convincingly meet the vessel rim. Lighting and surface textures are otherwise coherent; no distracting duplication.

Consistency: The white setting and dark finish remain, but the pot body is widened and made more frontal, a small right-side lug appears, and the handle attachment marking is lost. These exceed the permitted lid placement. Instruction: The formerly separate glass lid now sits across the pot opening with its knob upright and perimeter following the rim, matching the expected covered pot. Quality: Structure, perspective, lighting, and textures are satisfactory; the glass reflections, metal edge, and pot surfaces look coherent without noticeable generation artifacts.

Consistency: The white background, pot position, left tab, and long black handle remain visually consistent. The front pot contour is slightly fuller/lower, a small unintended change; the lid movement and its occlusion of the handle base are excluded. Instruction: The lid moves over the pot, but remains tilted and offset to the right with an exposed opening on the left. Expected placement would seat the lid on the rim; this realizes the main idea only partially. Quality: The lid-to-pot contact is structurally unconvincing, with a large unsupported-looking overhang and uneven gap. Glass and pot textures, lighting, and knob reflection are otherwise coherent.

Consistency: The white background, pot body, both handles, and scene arrangement remain visually consistent; the small marking at the long-handle base changes slightly. Instruction: The glass lid remains leaning beside/in front of the open pot, essentially its original placement. The expected change is a lid seated across the opening, which is absent; the instruction is not followed. Quality: Structure, naturalness, artifact absence, and texture fidelity are satisfactory. The leaning glass lid, rounded pot, handles, reflections, and ground shadow form a coherent product image.
